verdict.rationale: Solid's fine-grained signals give explicit, traceable state dependencies (solid-gh-1, solid-comm-19) and users report state changes feel 'intuitive and easy to debug' compared to React (solid-comm-10, solid-comm-7). However, some community feedback calls the reactive system 'non-intuitive' compared to Svelte and flags quirks like functions-as-props that complicate tracing reactivity (solid-comm-8, solid-comm-16), so the experience isn't universally frictionless.
